label: end-of-episode clock (last ~10 trials), at D1 and at D2 when S1 is shown
explanation: Fires only in the last trials of the 100-trial episode: 99.3% of activation mass is in ep_trials 90-99, none before trial 80, and every activation falls on steps where the value head is in its lowest bin (value < 5.22). That fits a time-to-end or low-value signal. It fires at D1 (67% of mass) and D2 (33%) and essentially never at GO. At D2 it fires almost only when S1 is shown (in_state S1 2.5x, S2 0.1x). Magnitude grows toward the episode end: ep_trial>=95 captures 84% of mass vs 78% of counts, and in example windows activations rise trial by trial. The biggest activations are at D1 after an unrewarded trial. Even inside the late window it is sparse (precision 0.39 at ep_trial>=95; 0.16 for all non-GO steps of trials 90+), so which late-episode steps fire is only partly explained. value<4 with the same phase/state gating scores about the same (F1 0.50, mass 0.91). Uses only observed or internally computable variables (episode position, current input).
